name: Familiar Spirits
overview: The Bible sternly forbids consulting familiar spirits, warning that seeking their guidance defiles the believer and provokes God's judgment. Leviticus commands the cutting off of those who turn to familiar spirits and prescribes death for those who practice such occult arts, emphasizing the seriousness of this sin. Deuteronomy further prohibits learning the abominable practices of surrounding nations, explicitly listing consulting with familiar spirits among forbidden activities. These passages reveal that reliance on familiar spirits is vain and contrary to God's holiness, underscoring the call to trust wholly in the Lord rather than occult sources.
